Basic Components of a Robotic System Robots use various types of sensors to perceive their surroundings. During this period of rapid technological growth, commercial interests were relatively minimal. However, in 1979, a popular word processing software called Scribe introduced a hidden, secret code in its program, marking the beginning of a new era.
